rule: Stage V: at most one conflict package; priority P_SCOPE, base E/F, P_BASIS, P_HEAD; opposite D0 two-seed mean gain vs D1/s0, at least one side |gain|>=0.01; cross-split conflict adds both sides at D1/s1.
reason: Highest fixed priority among detected conflicts.
stop_after: Stop this package after the two D1/s1 runs regardless of result; no second conflict package.
